school: 战国时期思想家，道家学派代表人物，宋国蒙人，曾为漆园吏
historical_significance: 庄子（约前369-约前286），名周，宋国蒙人，战国时期道家学派代表人物，与老子并称'老庄'。他做过漆园吏这类小官，一生贫困——曾借粟于监河侯、穿补丁衣见魏王——却拒绝楚威王以千金迎其为相的邀请，以'宁曳尾于涂中'的龟自喻，把自由置于权位之上。著有《庄子》五十二篇，今存三十三篇，分内、外、杂篇，内篇七篇（逍遥游、齐物论、养生主、人间世、德充符、大宗师、应帝王）历来被公认为庄子亲笔。《庄子》是中国哲学史上想象力最恢弘、文学性最强的哲学文本：鲲鹏展翅、庖丁解牛、庄周梦蝶、濠梁之辩、混沌凿窍等寓言构成了一个用故事而非论证来思想的独特体系。其哲学核心是'道'的遍在与'齐物'——以'天地与我并生，万物与我为一'消解是非、贵贱、生死、人我的一切对立，以'无用之用''心斋''坐忘'开辟超越功利的生存空间。郭象注庄使其成为魏晋玄学的核心文本，禅宗的形成、李白的诗风、苏轼的旷达、乃至后世文人的精神退路，无不打着庄子的印记。如果说老子为强者与统治者提供'守柔处下'的治理智慧，庄子则为一切个体——尤其是失意者——提供了在乱世中保全精神自由、把困境转化为审美与超越的完整生存技术。
historical_significance_en: Zhuangzi (c. 369-c. 286 BCE), personal name Zhuang Zhou, born in Meng in the state of Song, was the representative Daoist thinker of the Warring States period, paired with Laozi as 'Lao-Zhuang.' He held the minor post of a lacquer-garden official, lived in poverty—borrowing grain from the Marquis of Jianhe, wearing patched clothes before the King of Wei—yet declined King Wei of Chu's offer of a thousand in gold to make him chancellor, comparing himself to the tortoise that 'drags its tail in the mud,' placing freedom above office. His book, in fifty-two chapters of which thirty-three survive, is the most imaginative and literary philosophical text in Chinese history: the Kun-Peng's flight, Cook Ding's ox, Zhuang Zhou's butterfly, the debate on the Hao bridge, and Hun-dun's bored holes form a unique system that thinks in stories rather than syllogisms. Its core is the omnipresence of Dao and 'the equality of things'—dissolving all oppositions of right/wrong, noble/base, life/death, self/other under 'heaven and earth were born together with me, and the ten thousand things and I are one'—while 'the use of the useless,' 'fasting of the mind,' and 'sitting in forgetfulness' open a space of existence beyond utility. Guo Xiang's commentary made it the central text of Wei-Jin metaphysics; Zen Buddhism, Li Bai's poetry, Su Shi's equanimity, and the spiritual refuge of later literati all bear Zhuangzi's stamp. Where Laozi offered rulers the governing wisdom of yielding, Zhuangzi offered every individual—especially the thwarted—a complete technology for preserving spiritual freedom in a disordered age and converting predicament into aesthetic transcendence.
description_zh: 乱世中的精神自由技术：用寓言代替论证，用'齐物'消解一切对立，用'无用之用'在功利世界的缝隙里开辟逍遥之地——把贫困、危险与死亡都转化为自由的条件。
description_en: A technology of spiritual freedom in a chaotic age: replacing argument with parable, dissolving all oppositions through 'the equality of things,' opening ground for free wandering in the cracks of the utilitarian world through 'the use of the useless'—turning poverty, danger, and death itself into conditions of freedom.
key_works: 《庄子》内篇七篇（逍遥游、齐物论、养生主、人间世、德充符、大宗师、应帝王）
外篇杂篇（秋水、至乐、山木等）
濠梁之辩（与惠子游于濠梁之上）
拒绝楚威王聘相（宁曳尾于涂中）
key_concepts: 逍遥游（无待而游于无穷）
齐物论（万物齐一，是非两行）
无用之用（不材之木得终其天年）
庖丁解牛（依乎天理，以无厚入有间）
庄周梦蝶（物化与真实性之疑）
曳尾于涂中（自由高于权位）
混沌之死（日凿一窍而混沌死）
相忘于江湖（不如相濡以沫）
quote: 昔者庄周梦为胡蝶，栩栩然胡蝶也……不知周之梦为胡蝶与，胡蝶之梦为周与？周与胡蝶，则必有分矣。此之谓物化。——《庄子·齐物论》
quote_en: Once Zhuang Zhou dreamt he was a butterfly, fluttering happily as a butterfly... He didn't know if he was Zhou who had dreamt of being a butterfly, or a butterfly dreaming of being Zhou. Between Zhou and the butterfly there must be some distinction. This is called the transformation of things. (Zhuangzi, 'Discussion on Making All Things Equal')
